summary: Completed comprehensive testing of User/Provider Verification Feature. All 14 backend tests PASS. Frontend UI verified working for User Dashboard, Provider Dashboard, Verification Request page, and Admin Verification panel.

GET /api/verification/status.notes: Returns correct verification status for both users and providers. Includes status, documents, is_verified, user_type fields

POST /api/verification/request.notes: Accepts multipart/form-data with id_card, id_card_back, professional_license, additional_doc. Validates file types (JPEG, PNG, WEBP, PDF) and requires at least one document

GET /api/admin/user-verifications.notes: Admin can view all user verification requests. Supports status filter (pending/approved/rejected). Returns 403 for non-admin users

PUT /api/admin/user-verifications/{user_.notes: Admin can approve user verification. Sets is_verified=true and verification_status=approved. Creates notification for user
Admin can reject user verification with reason. Sets is_verified=false and verification_status=rejected. Creates notification for user
